title: Changing the customer selection narrows the table and refreshes the totals
preconds: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report with at least three customers in the current results.
steps:
1. Note the customers and the totals row values.
2. Open the Customer filter, clear all, and select exactly two customers.
3. Read the table rows and the totals row.
expected:
1. The report shows only the two selected customers.
2. The table refreshes as a fresh first page of results.
3. The totals row updates to cover only the selected customers' matching invoices.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S18-R5, S18-R11), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-2bf8d14 on 8/18/2026.
